title: The Tortoise and the Hare
summary: Удаан ч тууштай яст мэлхий хурдан туулайг уралдаанд хожсон Эзопын үлгэр.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Now, it is time for Words and Their Stories, a weekly program from VOA Learning English. … Until next time … I'm Anna Matteo.

changes: Excerpt: the introduction about the expression "slow and steady wins the race" and the closing lines were left out; the story and its lesson are complete.

questions.prompt: Why did Hare stop under the tree?
options: He wanted to rest and tease Tortoise
He hurt his leg and could not run
Fox told him to wait under the tree
questions.explain: Туулай "I'll just stay here under this tree and rest a bit" гэж хэлсэн. Яст мэлхийг гүйцэж ирэхэд нь "tease her some more" буюу дахин шоолохоор хүлээж байсан.

questions.prompt: What is the lesson of this story?
options: Fast animals always win their races
Rest often so you do not get tired
questions.explain: "The person who succeeds is ... the one who is the most focused and determined" гэж сургамжийг нь бичсэн.
